from itertools import islice

def prepare_batches(task_ids, size):
    """Remove duplicate task IDs and split them into fixed-size batches."""
    unique_ids = list(dict.fromkeys(task_ids))
    return [list(islice(unique_ids, size)) for _ in range((len(unique_ids) + size - 1) // size)]
